# Minimal SH1107 driver following the SH1107 datasheet command table (page addressing mode)
from micropython import const
import framebuf

class SH1107_I2C(framebuf.FrameBuffer):
    def __init__(self, width, height, i2c, addr=0x3C, col_offset=0):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        self.col_offset = col_offset
        self.pages = height // 8
        self.buffer = bytearray(self.pages * width)
        super().__init__(self.buffer, width, height, framebuf.MONO_VLSB)
        for c in (b'\xae', b'\xdc\x00', b'\x81\x2f', b'\x20', b'\xa0', b'\xc0', bytes([0xa8, height - 1]),
                  b'\xd3\x00', b'\xd5\x51', b'\xd9\x22', b'\xdb\x35', b'\xb0', b'\xa4', b'\xa6', b'\xaf'):
            self.write_cmd(c)
        self.fill(0)
        self.show()

    def write_cmd(self, c):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, b'\x00' + c)

    def show(self):
        for p in range(self.pages):
            self.write_cmd(bytes([0xb0 | p, self.col_offset & 0x0f, 0x10 | (self.col_offset >> 4)]))
            self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, b'\x40' + self.buffer[p * self.width:(p + 1) * self.width])
